assets.prompt: Create an editorial identity poster for a personal website. Subject: a young technical creator who builds AI-assisted education systems, curates research workflows, and also works with photography and video. Composition: warm studio desk seen from an elevated angle, layered with translucent acetate sheets, a film contact sheet, a few annotated system diagrams, and soft projected light. No readable text, no logos, no fake UI screenshots. Mood: authored, intelligent, cinematic, tactile, warm. Leave a calm negative-space region on the left for real website typography. High-detail editorial design, subtle pseudo-3D depth, paper grain, amber and graphite palette.
assets.negativePrompt: generic SaaS gradient, random neon blobs, fake readable text, fake UI screenshot, logos, corporate stock illustration, anime character, fan animation, cloth simulation

intendedUse.zh: 首页 manifesto 第一屏主视觉，配合真实 HTML 标题与 CTA。
intendedUse.en: Home manifesto first-screen visual paired with real HTML title and CTA.

frontendNotes.zh: 保留左侧或上方留白给文字；动画只做慢速视差、显影或纸张层次，不做物理 gimmick。
frontendNotes.en: Keep left or upper negative space for typography; use slow parallax, reveal, or paper-layer motion rather than physics gimmicks.

assets.prompt: Create an abstract dossier cover for an AI-supported SQL learning platform. Show a learning loop made of layered paper cards, query fragments as abstract marks, database grid forms, feedback annotations, and analytics traces. The image should suggest assessment, feedback, revision, and teaching insight without showing a fake app screenshot. Warm editorial palette with graphite, muted teal, cream paper, and small amber highlights. Cinematic top light, archival folder composition, clean negative space for website text. No readable text, no logos.
assets.negativePrompt: fake dashboard screenshot, unreadable UI text, corporate vector art, generic database icon, glossy 3D mascot, logos

intendedUse.en: Flagship dossier row on Projects or case-study cover on the project detail page.

frontendNotes.en: Use as a cover or background; do not replace the project's real architecture and flow diagrams.

assets.prompt: Create an abstract case-study cover for a student workflow product.
